meta.projection: Equal Earth (Šavrič et al. 2018), matching world-map.json

kernel.note: σ ≈ 550 km (floored to ≥16 map px) at mid-latitudes; weight = unique citing works per institution

hex.note: Equal-area hexbin on Equal Earth; target ~300 km, floored to ≥8 map px for readability.

meta.unit: Each institution contributes weight = unique non-self citing works listing that affiliation.
meta.sameScale: Lead density against All max (glow + hex) so Lead looks dimmer.

gaps.note: Works with no OpenAlex affiliation still count in the country choropleth. Institutions without coordinates contribute no glow/hex. Multi-campus systems plot at OpenAlex HQ.
